items.title: Chinese Threat Actor Uses Leaked DarkSword Kit to Deploy GHOSTBLADE on iOS
items.description: An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword exploit kit. Attack surface management platform Censys said it identified the threat actor running more than 100 web properties, most of which are fake Amazon Web Services (AWS) sign-in pages on a domain that also hosts the exploit toolkit. items.description: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web.
